analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 30.5 to 41.8, attempting to exit oversold. MACD histogram improved from -3.1918 to 0.2783, signaling bottoming. However, volume ratio at 0.85 lacks conviction, and weekly ADX at 21.2 indicates an early trend formation stage, making directional confirmation premature. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
